# Display Toggle Visibility & Selection Behavior

## Problem

The "Display → Stations" toggle exists in the UI but does not actually hide station markers or prevent their selection. Users expect that hiding stations would:
1. Make station markers invisible
2. Prevent accidental selection of hidden stations
3. Disable station-specific tool operations

Additionally, a "Shots" toggle is needed to control shot line visibility, with proper interaction with the existing "Virtual Shots" toggle.

## Key Files

| File | Purpose | Key Lines |
|------|---------|-----------|
| `src/store/uiStore.ts` | Display toggle state, selection state | L143 (showStations), L216-226 (DisplayToggleKey), L279 (clearSelection), L349 (defaults) |
| `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx` | Layer visibility methods, layer IDs | L44-50 (layer IDs), L600-625 (visibility methods pattern) |
| `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx` | Toggle sync hooks, snap logic | L517-528 (useEffect pattern), L103-115 (snap logic) |
| `src/components/SingleSystemView/DisplayMenu.tsx` | Toggle UI | L11-32 (displayOptions), L15 (showStations entry) |
| `src/hooks/useMapTools.ts` | Tool handlers | L75-183 (handleStationClick), L186-217 (handleShotClick) |
| `src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts` | Keyboard shortcuts | L108 (Ctrl+A select all) |

## Approach

### Core Visibility Implementation

**Stations Toggle (`showStations`):**
- Add `setShowStations(visible: boolean)` method to `SurveyLayer` class (follow pattern at L600-625)
- Use MapLibre `setLayoutProperty(layerId, 'visibility', 'none')` to hide `survey-stations` layer
- Also hide related layers: `survey-merges`, `survey-loop-closures` (they reference stations)
- Sync toggle state from `MapCanvas.tsx` via useEffect hook (follow pattern at L517-528)

**New Shots Toggle (`showShots`):**
- Add `showShots: boolean` state to `uiStore.ts` (default: `true`, add to L143 area)
- Add to `DisplayToggleKey` type (L216-226)
- Add `setShowShots(visible: boolean)` method to `SurveyLayer` class
- Controls visibility of `survey-shots` layer (L44)

**Important**: MapLibre's `queryRenderedFeatures()` automatically returns empty for hidden layers, which naturally blocks click detection in handlers at SurveyLayer.tsx L407-437.

### Toggle Relationships

**When `showShots` is OFF:**
- Hide all shot lines (regular + virtual)
- Disable (gray out) "Virtual Shots" toggle in DisplayMenu
- Disable (gray out) "Shot Data" toggle in DisplayMenu
- Shot Data labels also immediately hide

**When `showShots` is ON:**
- Re-enable "Virtual Shots" and "Shot Data" toggles
- Restore their previous states (Zustand cascade pattern in `set()` callback)

**Station Labels**: Remain independently controllable (user decision from interview) - labels may float at positions even when markers are hidden.

### Selection Behavior

**When Stations Hidden:**
- Clear selected stations immediately via `clearSelection()` or filtered clear (L279)
- Disable station hover effects (`hoveredStation` should also clear)
- Block station selection - `queryRenderedFeatures` naturally returns empty
- Show throttled toast: "Enable 'Stations' in Display menu to interact with station markers"

**When Shots Hidden:**
- Clear selected shots immediately
- Clear `hoveredShot` state
- Block shot selection
- Similar throttled toast for shots

**Mixed selection**: Only clear the type being hidden; keep the other selected. Filter `multiSelection` array by type.

### Toast Notification System

**No toast system exists** - need to create one:
- Add `toast: { message: string; timestamp: number } | null` to uiStore
- Add `showToast(message: string)` action with throttle logic (5 second cooldown using timestamp comparison)
- Render toast in App layout (position: bottom-center, auto-dismiss after 3 seconds)
- Use unique throttle keys per message type

### Tool Behavior When Stations Hidden

| Tool | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| Select | Cannot select stations (queryRenderedFeatures returns empty) |
| Delete | Cannot delete stations; can delete selected shots |
| Merge | Disabled - show toast on attempt |
| Move Station | Disabled - show toast on attempt |
| Move Section | Still works (section-level operation) |
| Measure | Works for arbitrary points; snap indicators still work |
| Draw | Works; snap shows station temporarily |

### Snap Indicator Exception

**Key insight**: Snap logic at MapCanvas.tsx L103-115 iterates `stations` array directly, NOT through `queryRenderedFeatures`. This means snap WILL find hidden stations - this is intentional for usability.

When cursor snaps to a hidden station during Draw/Merge/Measure:
- Show the full station marker temporarily (not just snap ring)
- Use snapped visual state (cyan #00ffcc, 7px radius, 4px stroke)
- Origin station in Draw mode becomes visible during the operation
- Station returns to hidden when operation completes/cancels

### In-Progress Operation Handling

When visibility toggles change during an active operation:
- Cancel Draw operation (clear `drawFromStation`, pending points)
- Cancel Merge operation (clear `mergeStationA`, `mergeStationB`)
- Cancel Measure operation (clear `measureStart`, `measureEnd`)
- Cancel Placement mode if active
- Show toast: "Operation canceled - [stations/shots] hidden"
- Clear any temporary visual state

### Additional Layers to Hide

When stations hidden, also hide (they reference stations):
- `survey-merges` (L49) - dashed lines between merged stations
- `survey-loop-closures` (L50) - error indicators

Ghost layers (`survey-ghost-shots`, `survey-ghost-stations`) should also respect visibility during merge preview.

### Keyboard Shortcut Considerations

- `Ctrl+A` select all (L108 in useKeyboardShortcuts.ts): Should skip hidden elements or be blocked entirely when relevant elements hidden
- `Delete/Backspace`: Works on current selection (already validated)

### Persistence

- All display toggle states persist via `save_display_setting` IPC (L397-403 in uiStore)
- New `showShots` toggle should follow same pattern
- Toast state does NOT persist (ephemeral)

## Edge Cases

1. **Multi-section selection**: Clear all selected stations across all sections when hiding
2. **Mixed selection (stations + shots)**: Only clear the type being hidden
3. **Snap during hide**: Cancel snap state (`snappedStation: null`)
4. **Rapid toggle**: Toast throttle (5 second) prevents spam
5. **Toggle before map loaded**: Check `mapLoaded` state before calling layer methods
6. **Undo after visibility change**: Selection does NOT restore (state was explicitly cleared)
7. **Placement mode**: Cancel placement when visibility changes

## Quick Commands

```bash
# Run TypeScript check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Run E2E tests
pnpm test:ui

# Run Rust tests
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Stations toggle hides `survey-stations`, `survey-merges`, `survey-loop-closures` layers
- [ ] Hidden stations cannot be selected (queryRenderedFeatures returns empty)
- [ ] Hidden stations do not show hover effects
- [ ] Clicking hidden station area shows throttled toast (max once per 5 sec)
- [ ] Snap indicators work during Draw/Merge/Measure with hidden stations
- [ ] Snapped/origin stations become temporarily visible during tool operations
- [ ] Selection is cleared immediately when toggle turned off
- [ ] In-progress operations canceled with toast notification
- [ ] New "Shots" toggle controls `survey-shots` visibility
- [ ] "Virtual Shots" toggle disabled when "Shots" hidden
- [ ] "Shot Data" toggle disabled when "Shots" hidden
- [ ] Toggle states restore correctly when parent toggle re-enabled
- [ ] All toggle states persist across app restart
- [ ] Ctrl+A respects visibility (skips hidden elements)
- [ ] E2E tests cover visibility toggle behavior
- [ ] Unit tests cover state logic and toggle relationships

## Out of Scope

- Keyboard shortcuts for display toggles (separate epic)
- Station Labels auto-disable (user chose independent)
- Zero Datum toggle behavior (not discussed)

## References

- MapLibre visibility: `setLayoutProperty(layerId, 'visibility', 'none')`
- Zustand dependent state: cascade in `set()` callback
- Toast throttle: timestamp comparison with 5000ms threshold

# fn-3-e6v.4 Implement toggle disable relationships in DisplayMenu

## Description
Implement toggle disable relationships in DisplayMenu.

## File to Modify

### `src/components/SingleSystemView/DisplayMenu.tsx`

**Current structure (L11-32):**
The `displayOptions` array contains groups with items. Each item has `key`, `label`, `description`.

## Implementation

Need to make "Virtual Shots" and "Shot Data" toggles disabled when "Shots" is unchecked.

**Option 1: Extend item type with `disabledWhen`:**
```typescript
interface DisplayOption {
  key: DisplayToggleKey;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  disabledWhen?: DisplayToggleKey; // disabled when this toggle is false
}

// In displayOptions:
{ key: 'showVirtualShots', label: 'Virtual Shots', ..., disabledWhen: 'showShots' },
{ key: 'showShotData', label: 'Shot Data', ..., disabledWhen: 'showShots' },
```

**Option 2: Compute in render:**
```typescript
const isDisabled = (key: DisplayToggleKey) => {
  if (key === 'showVirtualShots' || key === 'showShotData') {
    return !showShots;
  }
  return false;
};
```

**Visual indication:**
- Disabled toggles: `opacity: 0.5`, `cursor: not-allowed`
- Checkbox: `disabled` prop set to true
- Retain checked state (don't reset value)

**Behavior:**
- When Shots re-enabled, dependent toggles restore to their previous values
- This happens naturally since we only disable UI interaction, not change the state
## File to Modify
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/DisplayMenu.tsx`

## Implementation Details

When "Shots" (`showShots`) is unchecked:
- "Virtual Shots" toggle should be disabled (grayed out)
- "Shot Data" toggle should be disabled (grayed out)

Visual indication:
- Disabled toggles show reduced opacity (e.g., `opacity: 0.5`)
- Cursor changes to `not-allowed`
- Checkbox is disabled but retains its checked state

Implementation approach:
1. Track `showShots` state
2. For Virtual Shots and Shot Data menu items, conditionally apply:
   - `disabled` prop to the checkbox
   - CSS class for visual styling

The disabled toggles should remember their state - when Shots is re-enabled, they restore to their previous values.

## Depends On
- Task 1: showShots state must exist
## Acceptance
- [ ] "Virtual Shots" toggle disabled when "Shots" is unchecked
- [ ] "Shot Data" toggle disabled when "Shots" is unchecked
- [ ] Disabled toggles have visual indication (reduced opacity, not-allowed cursor)
- [ ] Disabled checkbox has `disabled` prop
- [ ] Disabled toggles retain their checked state (not reset to false)
- [ ] When "Shots" re-enabled, dependent toggles immediately apply their stored values
- [ ] User cannot click/change disabled toggles
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

# fn-3-e6v.5 Clear selection and cancel operations when visibility changes

## Description
Clear selection and cancel in-progress operations when visibility changes.

## Files to Modify

### `src/store/uiStore.ts`

**Selection state (L50, L279):**
- `selection: Selection | null` - single selection
- `multiSelection: Selection[]` - multi-selection
- `clearSelection()` - clears both

**Operation state to clear:**
- `drawFromStation: StationId | null` (draw origin)
- `mergeStationA: StationId | null`, `mergeStationB: StationId | null` (merge targets)
- `measureStart: Coordinates | null`, `measureEnd: Coordinates | null` (measure points)
- `placementMode: boolean` (placement state)
- `snappedStation: StationId | null` (snap state)
- `hoveredStation: StationId | null`, `hoveredShot: ShotId | null` (hover state)

### `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx`

Add useEffect hooks to respond to visibility changes:

```typescript
// Clear station-related state when stations hidden
useEffect(() => {
  if (!showStations) {
    // Clear station selections
    const stationSelections = multiSelection.filter(s => s.type === 'station');
    if (selection?.type === 'station' || stationSelections.length > 0) {
      clearStationSelections(); // new action or filter logic
    }
    // Cancel station-related operations
    cancelStationOperations(); // clears draw, merge, snap state
    // Clear hover
    if (hoveredStation) setHoveredStation(null);
    // Show toast if operation was canceled
    if (drawFromStation || mergeStationA || placementMode) {
      showToast('Operation canceled - stations hidden');
    }
  }
}, [showStations]);

// Similar for shots...
```

## Implementation Notes

- May need new action `clearStationSelections()` that filters `multiSelection` by type
- Or modify existing `clearSelection()` to accept optional type filter
- Check if any operation was in progress before showing cancellation toast
## Files to Modify
- `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx` or relevant hook
- Potentially `src/hooks/useMapTools.ts`

## Implementation Details

### Clear Selection on Toggle
When `showStations` changes from true to false:
- Clear any selected stations from the selection state
- Keep any selected shots (if shots are still visible)

When `showShots` changes from true to false:
- Clear any selected shots from the selection state
- Keep any selected stations (if stations are still visible)

### Cancel In-Progress Operations
When visibility toggles change during an active tool operation:
- Cancel Draw operation (clear pending points)
- Cancel Merge operation (clear selected merge targets)
- Cancel Measure operation (clear measurement points)
- Show toast notification: "Operation canceled - [stations/shots] hidden"

## Depends On
- Task 3: Visibility toggle wiring must be in place
## Acceptance
- [ ] Selected stations cleared when `showStations` toggled off
- [ ] Selected shots cleared when `showShots` toggled off
- [ ] Mixed selections only clear the type being hidden
- [ ] `drawFromStation` cleared when stations hidden
- [ ] `mergeStationA` and `mergeStationB` cleared when stations hidden
- [ ] `measureStart`/`measureEnd` cleared if measuring to stations when hidden
- [ ] `placementMode` exited when visibility changes
- [ ] `snappedStation` cleared when stations hidden
- [ ] `hoveredStation` cleared when stations hidden
- [ ] `hoveredShot` cleared when shots hidden
- [ ] Toast "Operation canceled - stations hidden" shown if operation was active
- [ ] Toast "Operation canceled - shots hidden" shown if shot operation was active
- [ ] Clearing happens immediately on toggle change
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

# fn-3-e6v.7 Show snapped/origin stations during Draw/Merge/Measure

## Description
Show snapped/origin stations during Draw/Merge/Measure operations.

## Key Insight

**Snap logic bypasses layer visibility**: The `checkSnapToStation` function at MapCanvas.tsx L103-115 iterates over the `stations` array directly, NOT through `queryRenderedFeatures`. This means snap WILL find hidden stations - this is intentional.

The challenge is to make the snapped station VISIBLE even when stations layer is hidden.

## Files to Modify

### `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx`

**Approach**: Use MapLibre filter expressions to show specific stations while hiding others.

Instead of simple visibility toggle, use a filter:
```typescript
setShowStations(visible: boolean, exceptIds?: string[]): void {
  if (!this.map) return;
  
  if (visible) {
    // Show all stations
    this.map.setLayoutProperty(this.stationsLayerId, 'visibility', 'visible');
    this.map.setFilter(this.stationsLayerId, null); // clear filter
  } else if (exceptIds && exceptIds.length > 0) {
    // Hide all except specific IDs
    this.map.setLayoutProperty(this.stationsLayerId, 'visibility', 'visible');
    this.map.setFilter(this.stationsLayerId, ['in', ['get', 'id'], ['literal', exceptIds]]);
  } else {
    // Hide all
    this.map.setLayoutProperty(this.stationsLayerId, 'visibility', 'none');
    this.map.setFilter(this.stationsLayerId, null);
  }
}
```

**Alternative approach**: Maintain separate "exception" layer for temporarily visible stations.

### `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx`

When snap state changes, update the exception list:
```typescript
useEffect(() => {
  if (!showStations && surveyLayerRef.current) {
    const exceptIds: string[] = [];
    if (snappedStation) exceptIds.push(snappedStation);
    if (drawFromStation) exceptIds.push(drawFromStation);
    surveyLayerRef.current.setShowStations(false, exceptIds);
  }
}, [showStations, snappedStation, drawFromStation]);
```

## Visual State

Snapped stations should use the snapped visual style:
- Cyan color (#00ffcc)
- 7px radius
- 4px stroke width

This is already handled by `updateVisualState()` at L533-580 when `snappedStation` is set.
## Files to Modify
- `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx` (visual state updates)
- `src/hooks/useMapTools.ts` or tool handlers

## Implementation Details

### Snap Indicator Exception
When stations are hidden but user is using Draw/Merge/Measure tools:
- If cursor snaps to a station position, show the FULL station marker temporarily
- Not just the snap ring - the actual station circle becomes visible
- Use the snapped visual state (cyan #00ffcc, 7px radius, 4px stroke)

### Draw Tool Origin
When starting a Draw operation from an existing station:
- The origin station becomes visible for the duration of the draw
- Returns to hidden when draw completes or is canceled

### Implementation Approach
Modify the visual state update logic in `SurveyLayer.updateVisualState()`:
- Check if station is in snap/draw-origin state
- If so, override the hidden visibility for that specific station
- Use filter expressions to show specific stations while hiding others

Alternative approach:
- Maintain a "temporarily visible stations" set
- Union with snap/origin state
- Apply as exception to visibility rule

## Depends On
- Task 3: Base visibility must work first
## Acceptance
- [ ] Snapped station visible during Draw/Merge/Measure even when stations hidden
- [ ] Draw origin station visible during draw operation
- [ ] Visible exception stations use snapped visual style (cyan, larger)
- [ ] Exception stations return to hidden when operation completes
- [ ] Exception stations return to hidden when operation canceled
- [ ] Only specific exception stations shown, not all stations
- [ ] Works for merge (both stations A and B if snapped)
- [ ] Works for measure (start and end points if snapped to stations)
- [ ] Filter/exception logic doesn't break normal visibility toggle
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes
